dedupe_keys.name: two indian solar plants generation and weather measurements

description: Ani Kannal publishes generation and weather-sensor observations from two solar power plants in India over thirty-four days. Four CSV files form two pairs: inverter-level generation measurements and plant-level sensor readings. The provider explains that each inverter connects several panel lines, whereas one sensor array characterises the plant. Exact locations, calendar dates, sampling interval and field units are not stated in the inspected card. Access has no stated charge; Kaggle reserves data copyright to the original authors; no licence with an additional reuse grant is stated. A limitation is the difference in spatial support between inverter outputs and shared weather observations, and the short period cannot establish seasonal variability. Simulation uses include calibrating short-term solar-output relationships and checking monitoring inputs for cleaning or equipment-performance studies. It complements data-open-power-system-data with plant-level observations. No power traces, maintenance events or weather corrections were checked.
